data.name: Necropolitan
data.description: An undead master gains a +%1 bonus on Diplomacy and Knowledge checks regarding undead creatures. Because of his obsessive focus on the undead, he takes a -2 penalty when attempting such checks regarding living creatures.|max(1,WizardLVL/2)
